title: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Public dialysis services
Type: Public Healthcare Service
Details: Programme supporting access to dialysis through designated public facilities and PPP arrangements, subject to state implementation.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Patients requiring dialysis who meet service and facility conditions in the relevant state/UT.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Doctor's referral/clinical assessment, diagnostic records and identity or registration details as required by facility.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Contact district hospital or designated public dialysis centre to confirm availability, registration and charges.
Official Portal: https://nhm.gov.in/
